one_voice_plays_several_characters: no — no spoken dialogue; the Mom-vs-Dad contrast comes from the song's female-to-male vocal shift.

music.description: electro-rock / hyperpop anime song with distorted guitars, heavy 808s, gunshot kicks, female/male vocals
music.identified_track: BBpanzu feat. Starxrayne & JamsDX - Bang Bang Bang
music.lyrics_heard: battle legendary / Our fickle fraternizing / A war inside my heart / Until [death] do us part / Bang, bang, bang, bang, bang / 'Til I take you / Down, down, down, down
music.how_it_follows_the_story: Opens mid-pre-chorus (0:00.0-0:04.9) with Starxrayne's bright female vocal over Mom's photos; as 'Dad's old photos' appears (0:04.9), drums drop out (0:05.5-0:06.3) with a gun-cock click on 'Until [death] do us part', then slam into the bass-boosted 808/gunshot chorus at 0:06.4 ('Bang, bang, bang...') with JamsDX's lower male vocals joining over Dad's baby, warzone, and sportbike photos to 0:11.5.

sound_effects.sound: metallic gun cock / reload click in drum dropout

sync_with_picture: Beat-locked to 140 BPM (~1.2-1.4s / 3 beats per shot): Mom's photos cut at 0:00.4, 0:01.2, 0:02.4, 0:03.7; Dad on the couch hits at 0:04.9 into the 0:05.5-0:06.3 drum mute; baby Dad hits the first chorus 'Bang!' (0:06.4); the warzone explosion cuts squarely onto the 4th 'bang' peak (0:07.7); sportbike shots land on beat at 0:09.2 and 0:10.6.
faces_and_mouths: No speaking or lip-sync; posed R6 photo tableaux hold static 2D decals (Mom's grin, pacifier, tongue-out; Dad's stoic mustache/shades, scarred soldier scowl, cool biker) with post camera shake/zoom.
comedic_or_emotional_timing: Musical structure is the joke: 0:00.0-0:04.9 pairs wholesome Mom photos with melodic female pre-chorus, 0:05.5-0:06.3 pulls the drums out for suspense as Dad holds up his phone, and 0:06.4 unleashes distorted 808s, gunshots, and male vocals as Dad's lore escalates from duck pajamas (0:06.4) to combat (0:07.7) to sportbikes (0:09.2).
first_3_seconds: Full-scale -10.2 dB RMS cold start at 0:00.0 mid-phrase ('battle legendary / Our fickle fraternizing') at 140 BPM across rapid photo cuts (0:00.0, 0:01.2, 0:02.4) — immediate hyperpop energy with zero fade-in.
ending: Hard-cuts at 0:11.5 on the 4th 'down' with no fade; matching 140 BPM energy between 0:11.5 (-20.9 dB) and 0:00.0 (-22.3 dB) drives a tight replay loop.
mix: Ultra-loud, heavily compressed/bass-boosted master (-8.5 LUFS, LRA 1.2 LU, 0.3 dBTP) with 64.7% energy <80 Hz after the 0:06.4 808 drop; vocals stay bright above intentionally saturated kicks.
why_the_sound_works: Female-to-male vocal shift + beat drop at 0:04.9-0:06.4 embodies 'Mom vs. Dad lore' with zero narration needed.
The 0:05.5-0:06.3 drum dropout + 0:05.6 gun-cock creates a 0.8s suspense pocket before the 0:06.4 chorus slam.
Cutting the warzone explosion photo directly onto the 4th 'Bang!' gunshot transient (0:07.7) rewards rewatches.
Short 11.5s runtime at -8.5 LUFS and 140 BPM maximizes loop completion.
unsure_about: The 0:05.6 gun-cock and 0:06.4-0:08.2 gunshot kicks are baked into the bass-boosted edit of 'Bang Bang Bang' rather than separate foley, though the 0:07.7 warzone cut is explicitly timed to the 4th gunshot.
